decision_references: Replace bulk-rating requests to senior researchers with bounded methodological-adviser requests
Recruit early-career expert raters for the bulk work
Use the pilot results and senior feedback to support the LTFF and Emergent Ventures applications
Expand to the full 400 critiques only after external funding or substantial committed volunteer capacity is secured
purpose: Demonstrate that Metaphilosophy can collect blind, auditable, multi-rater expert judgments on philosophical critiques.
Estimate rating time, disagreement frequency, adjudication load, and operational cost before any 400-critique expansion.
Produce a controlled sample, reliability analysis, platform audit trail, and methodological-adviser feedback suitable for external-funding applications.
Test a scalable expert-judgment workflow; do not claim that 48 critiques are sufficient to train a materially better model.

relationship_to_lmca.reason: The canonical row-level dataset and redistribution license have not been supplied. The pilot must not depend on unavailable or uncleared rows.
design_responses: Every pilot critique receives two independent blind initial ratings rather than relying on a single primary rater.
Every selected position has four critiques to support within-position comparison.
Source identity, model identity, provisional quality strata, and other confounding metadata remain hidden during rating.
Original ratings are preserved when adjudication or re-rating occurs.
Position context, intended conclusion, and ambiguity notes are frozen before rating to reduce interpretation-driven disagreement.

source_policy.remaining_position_rule: Select the remaining four positions from either eligible class to improve topic coverage, difficulty, source/style balance, and readiness; do not introduce LMCA rows unless the canonical data and license are separately approved.
rights_and_provenance_requirements: Every position and critique has a versioned source and authorship record.
Protected public-domain-derived positions pass independent source-fidelity and ambiguity/scope review before critique production.
Public synthetic critiques remain labeled internally as previously unrated candidates until new expert ratings exist.
No hidden item IDs, text, critiques, labels, or split assignments appear in public manifests.

selection_objectives: Include one candidate with high judge mean and low judge disagreement.
Include one plausible candidate with low judge mean and low judge disagreement.
Include two candidates with high judge disagreement or distinct attack families.
Avoid selecting four critiques whose apparent quality is predictable from length, source, model identity, formatting, or tone.
Prefer critiques that attack distinct substantive issues while preserving a useful within-position quality spread.
frozen_before_human_rating: blind assignment seed and controlled manifest hash
hidden_from_raters: source and author or model identity
adjudication status until the initial rating is locked

rating_protocol.analysis_rule: Use strength multiplied by centrality rather than either field alone when scoring substantive impact.
rating_protocol.presentation: Each assigned rater sees all four critiques of a position in a rater-specific randomized order, with the frozen position context visible and source metadata hidden.
rating_protocol.independence: Initial ratings are locked before any other rating, aggregate, model judgment, or adjudication record is exposed.
rating_protocol.revision_policy: Preserve every original rating. Revisions require an object-level reason and create a new version; disagreement alone is not a sufficient reason to revise.

assignment_design.pairing_rule: Assign each position to exactly one pair of core raters, minimize repeated rater pairs, balance topic families, and avoid known conflicts or prior exposure.
blindness_checks: No rater receives a position they authored, edited substantively, or previously saw with labels.
No rater sees the paired rater's identity or ratings before locking all four sibling critiques.
Assignment logs record eligibility, conflict checks, exposure state, and deterministic seed.

adjudication_protocol.independence: Both dedicated adjudicators independently review every required case before seeing the other's disposition.
case_record: whether item text or context is defective
final status or documented unresolved status
adjudication_protocol.consensus_policy: Do not force consensus. Preserve original and revised ratings and publish uncertainty or unresolved interpretation where appropriate.
adjudication_protocol.final_signoff: Both adjudicators independently sign the frozen label snapshot and audit completeness record.

methodological_adviser_protocol.maximum_request: Review a two-page protocol asynchronously in approximately 20 minutes or join one 30-minute call.
questions: What is the largest threat to the pilot's validity or usefulness?
Which rubric, assignment, or adjudication rule should be changed before launch?
What evidence would make the pilot meaningfully informative beyond the existing LMCA work?
prohibited_asks: perform operational data cleaning or routine adjudication
methodological_adviser_protocol.feedback_record: Record adviser comments, resulting changes, and unresolved disagreements in a versioned methodological-feedback log.

primary_outputs: median and distribution of rating time
absolute gaps in overall and strength-times-centrality
source, length, topic, and rater effects
agreement_metrics: Krippendorff alpha or an equivalent interval-aware coefficient by dimension
weighted pairwise ordering agreement within positions
scale_readiness_criteria: All 96 required blind initial ratings are accepted or validly replaced.
Median time for an accepted initial rating is no more than 15 minutes.
Weighted within-position pairwise agreement is at least 0.75 for critique pairs whose mean overall-score gap is at least 0.20.
At least 9 of 12 positions contain a consensus overall-score spread of at least 0.30 across their four critiques.
No more than 25 percent of critiques remain unresolved because of defective context, source fidelity, ambiguity, or scope after adjudication.
The rating, revision, adjudication, exposure, and payment audit trails are complete.
analysis_plan.interpretation: Failure to meet a scale-readiness criterion triggers protocol or item redesign; it must not be hidden by redefining the metric after results are known.

deliverables: versioned re-ratings and adjudication records for every triggered case
frozen label snapshot with uncertainty metadata
pilot analysis report and reproducible metric code
two-page public methodology and limitations summary
evidence packet for Long-Term Future Fund and Emergent Ventures applications

required_before_activation: Pilot completion gate passes and scale-readiness findings are reviewed.
Senior methodological feedback is recorded and material concerns are resolved or disclosed.
External funding is secured or documented qualified volunteer commitments cover the complete 400-critique workload, expected re-ratings, adjudication, replacements, and operations.
The project owner explicitly approves activation of the 400-critique programme in a new decision record.
